description: Na₄Zr₂TiMnSi₄(O₈F)₂ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. There are two shorter (2.42 Å) and two longer (2.65 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.36 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.94 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.24 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.57-2.71 Å. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.23 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MnO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-69°. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.32 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.06 Å. Mn is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form MnO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 64°. There are two shorter (2.18 Å) and two longer (2.33 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. Both Mn-F bond lengths are 2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-76°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MnO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-65°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Zr, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₂ZrSi trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, corners with three ONaTiMnSi trigonal pyramids, and edges with two ONaZr₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Zr, one Ti, and one Mn atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to three Na and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ti, one Mn, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaTiMnSi trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, corners with two ONa₂ZrSi trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaTiMnSi trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Zr, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaZr₂Si trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂ZrSi trigonal pyramids, and edges with two ONaZr₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form FNa₃Mn tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, corners with five ONa₂ZrSi trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaTiMnSi trigonal pyramid.
